name: zebjus-flightcore-drone-lab
description: ZEBJUS Aerion — Build, Code, Fly with offline Python and drone simulation

scripts.test:control: node tools/test_joystick_runtime.js && node tools/test_reconnect_runtime.js && node tools/test_firmware_updater.js && node tools/test_usb_recovery.js && node tools/test_camera_lifecycle.js && node tools/test_python_output_lifecycle.js
scripts.release:seal: python3 -B tools/cleanup_repo.py && python3 -B tools/make_offline_manifest.py && python3 -B tools/release_integrity.py --write
scripts.test:fc-setup: g++ -std=c++17 tools/test_fc_setup.cpp -o /tmp/aerion-fc-setup && /tmp/aerion-fc-setup && python3 -B tools/test_receiver_storage.py && python3 tools/test_fc_setup_runtime.py && g++ -std=c++17 tools/test_training_runtime.cpp -o /tmp/aerion-training-runtime && /tmp/aerion-training-runtime && python3 -B tools/test_simulator_rc_runtime.py && g++ -std=c++17 tools/test_simulator_udp_runtime.cpp -o /tmp/aerion-simulator-udp && /tmp/aerion-simulator-udp
scripts.test:rc-monitor: node tools/test_rc_live.js && g++ -std=c++17 tools/test_rc_monitor.cpp -o /tmp/aerion-rc-monitor && /tmp/aerion-rc-monitor && python3 -B tools/test_rc_monitor_runtime.py
scripts.test:wifi: python3 -B tools/test_wifi_runtime.py && node tools/test_ap_discovery.js && node tools/test_mobile_wifi.js
scripts.test:stability: node tools/test_connection_stability.js && node tools/test_destination_ownership.js && node tools/test_tripod_direction.js && python3 -B tools/test_http_recovery_runtime.py
